root_idea.summary: The root centers on causing blood to flow or be poured out.
root_idea.development: Its lexical range extends from shedding blood to pouring forth tears, water, and other fluids; derived forms also express flowing, mutual bloodshed, intensive agency, and figurative outpouring of speech.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form سَفَكَ rather than the imperfect QAC lemma.

senses.definition: To shed blood; to cause blood to flow.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrences, the verb is used with blood as its object, in the construction of shedding blood.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pour forth tears, water, molten material, or another fluid.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader Classical Arabic application of the Form I verb to liquids other than the Quran-attested blood use.
Used figuratively of abundant speech, especially when delivered hastily or quickly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To feed a guest with something that satisfies hunger before the morning meal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form II usage concerning preliminary food given to a guest.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To engage together in mutual shedding of blood.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal Form VI construction describing contending parties who shed one another’s blood.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be shed, poured forth, or to flow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of blood, tears, water, or another fluid as undergoing or exhibiting the flowing action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A portion of food presented to a guest to satisfy hunger before the morning meal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for the food portion itself.
A figurative application to the soul, presented as an assumed metaphorical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Shed, poured forth, or caused to flow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive descriptive use applied to blood, tears, water, or another fluid.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who sheds blood or tears abundantly; a great shedder of blood.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive agent description, especially for a habitual or prolific shedder of blood.
A figurative Classical Arabic application to a person’s speaking ability.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Mendacious; a habitual or great liar.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative intensive description of persistent lying, including lying in speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Shedding or pouring forth blood, tears, or other fluids.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active-participial description of the one or thing performing the pouring action.
A figurative descriptive use for excessive talkativeness.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Blood shedding is Quran-attested; the broader liquid applications are separately retained.
Figurative usage applied to the soul.
Passive state of fluids being shed or poured.
Intensive shedder of blood or tears.
Active participial description of shedding or pouring.
Inflectional and illustrative clarification of the active participle.
